chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Ḥakam asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about a woman who testified against a man that he had pushed a boy into a well, and he died.
He عليه السلام said: "Upon the man is one-fourth of the blood money of the boy, based on the testimony of the woman."

key_terms.بِشَهَادَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ: on the basis of the woman's testimony
key_terms.دِيَةِ: blood money; prescribed financial compensation for unlawful killing or injury
key_terms.شَهِدَتْ: she gave testimony or bore witness

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling when a woman testifies that a man caused a boy's death by pushing him into a well?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the evidentiary value of a woman's testimony in a case involving the death of a child. The Imam عليه السلام rules that, on the basis of her testimony, the man is liable for one-fourth of the boy's diyah.
